ai.chat.empty: No conversations yet. Write a message to start.
ai.chat.disabled: The AI assistant is switched off by the administrator.
ai.chat.no_key: No API key configured. An administrator can set it under Settings → AI.
ai.chat.error: The request to the AI provider failed.
ai.logs.title: AI call log
ai.mcps.title: MCP servers
ai.mcps.empty: No MCP servers yet. Add one to give the assistant external tools.
ai.mcps.intro: Tools from external MCP servers are offered to the assistant for users holding ai.mcp.use, in this tenant only.
ai.mcps.name: Name
ai.mcps.forbidden: You do not have permission to view MCP servers
ai.mcps.load_failed: MCP servers could not be loaded
ai.mcps.form.code_hint: Lowercase letters/digits/hyphens. Tool name on the wire: ext_<code>__<tool>
ai.mcps.form.headers_hint: One per line, "Name: value" — e.g. Authorization: Bearer xxx. Values are stored as secrets and shown as ***; leave *** to keep them.
ai.mcps.form.enabled: Enabled — its tools are offered to the assistant
ai.widget.title: AI assistant
ai.providers.title: AI providers
ai.providers.new_hint: An OpenAI-compatible provider profile with a priced model list. Prefer providers that support /responses + reasoning/tools. The first profile becomes the default; until one exists, Settings → AI applies.
ai.providers.intro: Several providers/models per tenant; users pick one per conversation. Cost is computed from each model's price list.
ai.providers.empty: No provider profiles yet — the assistant uses Settings → AI.
ai.providers.recommended_hint: Supports the modern /responses endpoint plus reasoning or tools
ai.providers.sorted_hint: Recommended providers are listed first. This ordering is display only — the default provider for chat is still the one marked default.
ai.providers.probe_partial: Some steps failed or timed out — a capability shown as unsupported may in fact be there. Test again if the network is slow.
ai.providers.no_key_hint: No API key stored — chats through this provider are refused with an actionable message.
ai.providers.key_set: API key stored (never shown). Fill the field to replace it.
ai.providers.deleted: Provider removed; conversations pinned to it fall back to the default.
ai.providers.test_hint: Runs the capability probe with the stored key: checks /responses and /chat/completions, streaming, reasoning and tools — then lists the model ids you can add to the price list.
ai.providers.tested_models_hint: Copy the ids you use into the model & price list above.
ai.providers.model_test_hint: The capability matrix belongs to the model, not just to the base URL: one provider commonly serves a reasoning model, a chat-only one, and a model without function calling. Test each model you intend to offer.
ai.providers.model_default_hint: Testing the connection above probes the default model and fills its row in too.
ai.analytics.title: AI analytics
ai.analytics.intro: Tokens and estimated cost per day, model and user in this tenant, from the call log.
ai.analytics.tokens_reasoning_hint: The share of output tokens the model spent thinking. Billed like any other output.
ai.analytics.cost_hint: Estimated from the model price list; — when unpriced.
ai.analytics.truncated: This window has more than 100,000 calls; figures use the newest 100,000.
ai.quota.title: Quota & balance
ai.quota.intro: Monthly token limits (Settings → AI) and the tenant's prepaid balance; requests are refused when exhausted.
ai.quota.settings_hint: Token quotas live in Settings → AI; the balance is managed below.
ai.quota.exhausted: AI quota or balance exhausted; requests are refused until next month or a top-up.
ai.float.open: Ask the AI assistant about this page
ai.float.title: AI assistant
ai.float.empty: The assistant knows which page you are on. Ask anything.
ai.chat.attach_hint: Images, text, CSV, JSON, Markdown — up to 5 files @ 5 MB
